entries.headline: The desktop app grows up: setup, updates, notes
entries.summary: A fresh install now opens a short setup wizard, and the app updates itself in one click. It also carries its own version and release notes, separate from yeaboi.

highlights.text: First run walks you through connecting a model, then voice, video and tools
Everything after the model is skippable — get going in under a minute
A new version downloads and installs in one click, then restarts for you
What's New keeps app changes and yeaboi changes apart, terminal notes aside
